steps.instruction: Grab the yellow and red bottle and hold it in place
While holding the bottle in place, grab a blue flower by its stem, right below the flower petals.
While holding the bottle in place, insert the end of the flower stem into the top of the bottle.
While holding the bottle in place, lower the flower stem into the bottle.

done_instruction: Return both arms to the home position.
flowers_left_question: Is any blue flower still on the table, outside the bottle? Answer with JSON: {"blue_flowers_left": bool}
system_prompt: You check a robot manipulation scene from three cameras: front, left_wrist and right_wrist. In the front image the robot's right arm appears on the left side and its left arm on the right side. Only blue flowers count; flowers already in the bottle do not count, and neither do flowers of other colors. Answer with exactly one JSON object and nothing else.
